seed_fact: Ask: 'Can I edit my own content after launch?' If no, walk away.
caption:
Can you change your website after it goes live? If the platform won’t let you update text, images, or prices yourself, you’ll be stuck paying someone else every time. Choose a site that puts control in your hands. DM me to discuss a site that lets you edit with confidence.
